text:
sam: quick heads-up: saw token corruption on runtime 3.3 + SDK 2.8 when serving quant-v3b on long contexts. proposing eu-west soft-pin to 3.2.1.
ivy: how bad? any customer impact?
sam: low percent but wrong tokens in outputs for regen tests (~0.4%). internal canary only so far.
omar: region-only pin sounds good. keep TTL small and add alert-based reroute.
sam: suggested deploybot command:
```bash
/deploybot pin add --model quant-v3b --runtime 3.2.1 --regions eu-west --ttl 3h --reason "quant decode corruption with runtime 3.3"
```
deploybot: applying pin -> applied to 26 nodes, pin id pin-9001.
oncall-bot: posted note to #ops: "pin-9001 applied for quant-v3b in eu-west; TTL 3h"
ivy: running smoke eval now. will report in 15m.
omar: I'll create reroute policy: if decode_errors > 25/min for 10m route quant-v3b -> quant-v3a.
sam: thanks team. will revisit after smoke.
